summary: Phase 5.1B Market Microstructure Guard testing complete. 40/40 pytest tests PASSED. All endpoints return 200. Frontend /admin/futures/microstructure-guard renders with all required widgets.
critical_code_review_comments: All 6 detector modules implemented with deterministic behavior: SpreadShockDetector, OrderbookThinningDetector, LiquidityVacuumDetector, QuoteStabilityDetector, SlippageAnomalyEstimator, LiquidityDisappearanceHeuristic
MicrostructureRiskAggregator: Properly aggregates scores from all detectors with weighted formula and returns risk_level (SAFE/WARNING/CRITICAL/BLOCKED)
MicrostructureGate: Evaluates all detector results and returns gate_pass with MICROSTRUCTURE_* reason codes
ExecutionSuitabilityEvaluator: Determines execution_suitable, severity, max_allowed_size_ratio, leverage_cap_override based on gate and risk level

GET /api/admin/futures/microstructure/status: Returns complete contract with portfolio_microstructure_state, portfolio_microstructure_risk_score, symbols_at_risk, gate_rejections, execution_suitability, symbols[]
Strategy paper decision flow integrates microstructure guard: signals rejected with MICROSTRUCTURE_* reason codes when gate fails
POST /api/admin/futures/strategy/run-paper-cycle: Returns microstructure block with gate_rejections and execution_suitability
Frontend page uses correct data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
UI displays all required widgets: Spread Shock Panel, Depth Thinning Heatmap, Quote Stability Stream, Slippage Counters, Risk Symbols, Execution Suitability Summary, Gate Rejection Chart
System remains paper-only - no live trading execution
seed_data_creation: None - microstructure data generated from live market cache (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT)
